tactics: induction j with | zero => intro l; rfl | succ j ih => intro l; cases l with | nil => rfl | cons a l => exact congrArg (a :: ·) (ih l)

induction j with | zero => intro l; simp [List.modifyTailIdx] | succ j ih => intro l; cases l with | nil => simp [List.modifyTailIdx, ← Nat.add_assoc] | cons a l => simp [List.modifyTailIdx, ← Nat.add_assoc, ih]
induction j with | zero => intro l; rfl | succ j ih => intro l; cases l <;> simp_all [List.modifyTailIdx, ← Nat.add_assoc]
induction j <;> intro l <;> cases l <;> simp_all [List.modifyTailIdx, ← Nat.add_assoc]
